sources.excerpt:
- **Archive parent:** GDS-20 Distortion
- **Builder:** CNZ Audio
- **Catalog type:** Distortion
- **Identity:** Compact analog distortion with Level, Gain and Tone controls plus a three-position Normal/Tight/Classic voicing switch. [1]

- **LEVEL:** Output.
- **GAIN:** Saturation amount.
- **TONE:** Brightness/clarity.
- **NORMAL / TIGHT / CLASSIC:** Three-way voicing switch. [1]

- Analog distortion.
- Three factory voicings are built into the signal path.
- No specific commercial clone lineage or component-level schematic is published by CNZ in the reviewed source.

- Exact production transistor/device part number is not publicly documented.

- Exact clipping-device type and part number are not publicly documented.

- **9V DC, center-negative**.
- Approximately **10 mA**.
- **470 kOhm input impedance**, **470 Ohm output impedance**. [1]

- Compact solid-aluminum mini enclosure.
- Standard 1/4-inch I/O. [1]

- No numbered electronic revision established.

Normal, Tight and Classic provide three broad distortion voicings, from more open/general-purpose response through tighter and more vintage-styled saturation. [1]

- **Identity:** High
- **Three-way voicing:** High
- **9V / 10mA:** High
- **Impedance data:** High
- **Exact transistor:** Unknown
- **Exact diode:** Unknown
- **Clone lineage:** Unknown

CNZ Audio's product page was checked directly and its model identity and specifications align with the historical Effects Database catalog record. [1][2]

1. CNZ Audio — GDS-20 Distortion: https://www.cnzaudio.com/products/gds-20
2. Effects Database — CNZ Audio catalog: https://www.effectsdatabase.com/model/cnz

- Exact-model photo status remains handled separately.
